# snipeit_manufacturer (Resource)

Manages a manufacturer in Snipe-IT.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "snipeit_manufacturer" "apple" {
  name          = "Apple"
  url           = "https://apple.com"
  support_url   = "https://support.apple.com"
  support_email = "support@apple.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the manufacturer. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `support_email` (String) Support email address of the manufacturer.
- `support_phone` (String) Support phone number of the manufacturer.
- `support_url` (String) Support website of the manufacturer.
- `url` (String) Website of the manufacturer.
- `warranty_lookup_url` (String) Warranty lookup URL of the manufacturer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the manufacturer.
